Design Manager-Senior Design Manager
 
Become one of the stars behind The SHOW and become part of the world’s most powerful entertainment brands. Our Company has one exciting mission: To entertain the human race.

Primary Purpose
It is the primary responsibility of the Senior Design Manager to provide design coordination efforts within the MRI Global Design and Development team, with emphasis on the project interior and/or architectural design efforts of our Japan Integrated Resort in Osaka. 

This individual must have the capability to handle multiple areas/projects concurrently from design through construction administration phases.  It is essential in this role to possess a high level of design creativity along with very articulate verbal communication skills.

The Senior Designer Manager has a complete grasp of all project design consultant’s roles and responsibilities and is able to advise and assist Interior Designers for the project, in understanding their responsibilities and meeting their project deliverables. This individual uses thoughtful communication, previous project experience and other interpersonal and technical skills to provide a level of leadership among the design team during daily project activities. 

A working knowledge of interior and/or architectural design, construction detailing, codes related to life safety and interior finishes/furnishings, and the specification of sustainable interior products is expected.

Job Responsibilities
•	Provide leadership in guiding the Project design with General Contractor and design consultants for architecture and/or interiors.
•	Work with our Japan-based team and other project stakeholders to establish design and construction strategies that allow for the integration and coordination of creative designs with a view toward elevating the customer experiences within the bounds of our project budget and schedule.
•	Work with our stakeholders and consultants to manage and coordination all aspects of interior design including lighting, signage, FF&E, and artwork.
•	Attend regular design related project meetings and represent our interests and positions as related to design.
•	Create monthly design reports including design activities, project schedules and milestones, risks and issues.
•	Review designs and provide clear and concise design direction to design teams. Contractors, fabricators and specialty suppliers. 
•	Review drawings and plans submitted by Architects and Design Consultants for conformance to the documented space and provide feedback based on our design content directions.
•	Provide direction for and/or review technical design, FF&E design and specifications provided by Architects, Designers, or fabricators.
•	Work as an integrated team member of our international team (Japan and USA) of design managers.
•	Work closely with our development partner to build consensus around design decisions.
•	Communicate, present, and discuss design directions and decisions with US based project stakeholders.
•	Be available to conduct frequent site visits and on-site coordination meetings as the project moves to the construction phase of work.
•	Organize submittals, mockups, prototypes, and shop drawings as necessary to receive reviews and approvals from project design and management leads.
•	Validate estimated project budgets and provide guidance to the interior design consultants in collaboration with the Project Management Director that meet project program, budget and timeline.

•	Strong presentation skills, specifically in an executive leadership setting.
•	Excellent organizational skills to function effectively with attention to detail while meeting established deadlines.
•	Be prepared to relocate or conduct frequent visits to Osaka throughout the duration of the project and especially during the construction phases.
•	Fluent with architectural, engineering and design industry terminology and practices.
•	Understanding of construction document setup related to ID scope.
•	Understanding of FF&E/ID specification parameters, Standards and formats.

•	Proficient understanding and experience in designing each of the holistic elements of an IR.

From fast answers to deep insights, Mintel has provided research and intelligence solutions to consumer-focused businesses for more than 50 years. 
With a combination of syndicated tools and customized insight solutions, we are the eyes and ears in the markets that matter and the insights behind 
our clients’ next big idea.
The Senior TA&HR Generalist will be based in Mintel’s Tokyo office and responsible for recruitment and selection to meet the staffing initiatives and 
special projects. You will serve as the first point of contact for employees, line managers, and the regional Human Resources team for all people-related 
requests. This is a “hands-on” position that requires interaction and visibility with all levels of the organization.
What You Will Be Doing
Recruitment: (80%)
• Provide Exceptional Client Service: Work collaboratively with our Hiring Managers throughout the business to understand their challenges, 
needs, and objectives within recruitment. You should also be focused on giving the candidate strong client service and providing complete, 
accurate, and inspiring information about Mintel and the position.
• Hire and Recruit for Quality Candidates: While we certainly look to achieve certain targets on vacancies, we focus first and foremost on the 
candidate being the right fit for the role. This means having a transparent dialogue with candidates on what they have done in their careers 
and what they are looking for to make sure it is a fit on both ends. You will also act as the first point of contact for new employees 
onboarding and represent Mintel accordingly.
• Leverage Data: Using our online recruiting resources and our ATS, Greenhouse, you will present consistent data to our leadership to 
understand patterns and trends along with areas we can improve our recruitment process.
• Review Credentials: Review resumes and candidate profiles to assess for appropriateness of skills, experience, and knowledge in relation to 
position requirements.
• Build a Pipeline & Employer Branding: You will work closely with existing recruitment agencies and keep them active by exchanging ideas 
and necessary business updates with external partners, 
Other HR tasks: (20%)
• On-boarding and Off-boarding: Facilitate smooth on-boarding and off-boarding process, coordinating with cross-functional team to deliver 
an exceptional first-day experience. Handle all HR tasks such as new hire induction and exit interviews.
• HR Support: Provide daily HR support to employees, performance management process, and tracking employee milestones. Provide 
monthly payroll changes to the regional payroll team. Maintain employee data and manage employee benefits (e.g. leave records etc.).
• HR Advisory: Provide HR advisory service to employees in relation to leave, medical, grievance matters, and all other employee relations 
matters.
• HR Communication: Assist in the communication and upkeep of the employee handbook. Drafting HR communication for HR-related 
updates to the employees in Japan.

• A culture that supports true collaboration whilst embracing remote working.
• Flexible start time and end time.

• Social events, both within the department and across the company.
• Generous annual leave and wider circle employee benefits.
• Additional one day off to celebrate your birthday.
• Giving back is part of our culture with this in mind, Mintel gives employees 2 days' leave per year to join local volunteering activities 
organised by our Mintel Gives (where applicable).
• Mental health and wellbeing support via Modern Health App

JOB DESCRIPTION
Position: Director of Human Resources
Scope of Job: ensuring the smooth and efficient running of the Human Resources
Division of the hotel and the implementation of Hyatt’s People Brand
throughout the hotel
Report to: General Manager
Place of Work: Park Hyatt Kyoto / Hyatt Centric Kanazawa
Our Purpose: We care for people so they can be their best
Care comes from a place of empathy and authentic human connection. We care by truly seeing
people and getting to know them as unique individuals so we can design and deliver personal
experiences. We want to make a difference in the lives of all those we touch: colleagues, guests,
owners, operators, community members, and shareholders. Being your best is about being your
authentic self in each moment – engaged, fulfilled, and ready to take on the world.
Leadership Expectations:
Lead with Purpose – The leadership expectations define the behaviors necessary to achieve
better business results and grow to meet future needs.
Champion Hyatt’s Purpose and Values:
Leaders inspire others through their actions, knowing that what they say must mirror what they
do in order to build trust and lead with integrity. They lead by example in genuinely caring for
others and practicing the values in their daily work – and encourage others to do the same. In
doing so, they create an environment for team wellbeing and all to succeed.
JOB DESCRIPTION
Practice empathy & inclusion
Practice means being proactive. When it comes to empathy and inclusion, it means
demonstrating genuine curiosity and willingness to understand others’ points of view and
concerns. Leaders listen to and value diverse points of view and each individual’s unique
background. With this ongoing practice, leaders will create an environment where all colleagues
feel safe to contribute and be fully engaged.
Act with integrity & respect
Actions speak louder than words, especially when it comes to building trust and showing
respect. The actions to demonstrate integrity and respect include celebrating the success of
others, active listening with a desire to fully understand, and interacting with openness and
honesty.
Support team wellbeing
Leaders can support team wellbeing by using creativity, connection and positivity to energize
the work and team environment. It also means learning to find a balance between work and
personal –both for themselves and for their team. Leaders who practice self-care lead by
example.
Experiment to Improve:
Leaders excel when they have a mindset that’s eager to grow and improve in all areas of their
work. They are not satisfied with the status quo and focus on delivering stakeholders’ needs.
Actions aren’t just based on a “feeling,” but instead are rooted in a pattern of prioritizing with
data and then testing and learning along the way. As a result, the experience for all
stakeholders is improved.
Demonstrate a growth mindset
If you aren’t moving forward, you’re falling behind. The best way to move forward is to
continuously improve, which begins with a mindset that’s growing is good and worthy of taking
on new challenges. All individuals can keep growing their abilities, skills and knowledge –
regardless of leadership level. This behavior also applies to work projects, initiatives, and
processes. Leaders who demonstrate a growth mindset see –and achieve –more of what’s
possible.
Prioritize with data
Data helps you see a situation more clearly, and –in turn –builds confidence in decision-making
and results in better outcomes. Data comes in many forms –quantitative and qualitative –but all
begins with being curious. Leaders who seek and consider diverse viewpoints as further data
points are better equipped to prioritize decisions effectively.
JOB DESCRIPTION
Test & learn
Ideas become reality in an environment that practices a consistent agile methodology of testing
with a small group, learning what worked (and what didn’t), then adjusting and testing again –
repeating the iterative process and seeing setbacks as ways to learn. An open mind, creativity
and flexibility to try new ways of doing things are important attributes, which –when combined
with a sense of urgency to make improvements –creates a leap toward success.
Understand the needs of others
To understand, you must first know. This means building rapport and asking questions. Then,
once you have the knowledge, understand how your role may help deliver on the needs of
others. “Others” includes all stakeholders that you interact with, such as guests, members,
customers and colleagues.
Drive for Impact:
Leaders bring the most value when they mobilize their team to move in the same direction and,
in doing so, accomplish more when they work together. To be effective, leaders must set their
sights ahead on the outcomes they’re aiming to achieve and bring this view into focus for their
teams by communicating the vision. Leaders empower their team members to be in the driver’s
seat, ensuring accountability and providing input as needed along the way.
Focus on outcomes
A clear destination creates a pathway to optimal productivity –knowing how to identify what
activities will yield the best results and how to prioritize effectively. By keeping focused on the
end goal, leaders are able to make better decisions and proactively allocate the right amount of
time and resources to achieve the most important priorities.
Ensure accountability
To be accountable simply means to know what you’re supposed to do, by when and with what
resources –and then go do it. While this may seem straightforward, leaders help keep
themselves and others accountable for their actions by owning decisions and also providing
timely and direct feedback on performance. Being accountable and accepting responsibility also
instills a sense of pride and achievement upon success.
Break down silos
No one works in isolation; each role connects to and impacts others. It's important to have a full
understanding about how your role and team fits within the larger organization so that you can
take responsibility for proactively connecting with other teams. With this big-picture view, you’ll
see more opportunities open up for collaboration and cooperation –and with a shared
understanding, you’ll be able to better prioritize your efforts for mutual rewards.
JOB DESCRIPTION
Communicate & influence
Listening is a virtue, but so is speaking up –especially when you proactively share knowledge,
information and feedback that can help others perform better. Leaders also help “connect
the dots” in how day-to-day tasks impact larger team and organizational goals. Leaders
also should exert their influence to inspire others to be –and do –their best.
Develop Diverse Talent:
Leaders succeed when others succeed. This mutuality comes to
life when leaders openly share their knowledge and experience and provide opportunities for
others through increasing responsibilities and career choices. Leaders play the role of coach and
mentor by helping to navigate barriers and opening up opportunities to connect with their networks.
Leaders grow the talent pipeline and grow the business –and, in doing so, grow their own career
path.
Coach & mentor
Ongoing development –both formally through a plan and also informally through on-the-spot twoway
conversations –is paramount to ongoing improvement in growing capabilities and careers.
Leaders can help grow others’ careers when they proactively identify opportunities to coach and
mentor colleagues with different backgrounds and experiences.
Foster connections
Hyatt colleagues rely on relationships to get things done, and the power of these connections is
exponential when they are intentionally pursued with those who come from different backgrounds
and experiences. The more people you know, the more your world expands. Strong connections
with colleagues are instrumental in collecting input into decisions and solving challenges. Leaders
are generous with their networks, and proactively seek connections with others beyond their own
function and background.
Enable success
Leaders can best enable success when they provide guidance and direction about what outcomes
need to be achieved and connect their team’s work to Hyatt’s purpose and values. In addition,
they allocate the resources needed to reach those outcomes, then get out of the way so that the
team members can make decisions and take independent action.
JOB DESCRIPTION
Main Duties & Responsibilities:
Position Summary
 This role will partner people managers & leaders at all levels with their growth and
development to help them become more effective leaders and managers.
 You will coach people managers/leaders to build HR capability around compensation
planning, performance management, goal setting, talent reviews
 You will work on manager capability building to enable managers to handle difficult and
effective conversations around how to develop employees and teams.
 Project work in partnership with RVP of Human Resources and Area Director of Human
Resources in the design, development and implementation of people programs.
 You will coach managers through people related issues as well as formal Hyatt processes.
 You will be advisor to people managers on building culture of compliance.
 Facilitate new manager assimilations and ramp up.
 Partner with senior leaders and executives on their respective people plans, including hiring,
diversity and inclusion plans.
 Partner with Corporate HR and internal resources to execute corporate-wide people
initiatives.
 Partner with Corporate HR, General Manager and Leadership Committee members, and

About the job
BATJ

Job Description

Title Senior Commercial Finance Manager 

Function Finance

Report to Area Commercial Finance Controller

Work Location Tokyo, Japan 

Role Summary

The Finance department in BATJ exists to provide both strategic directions / guidance to the management and the organization of BAT Japan Group (the “Group”) and operational finance services the Group in order to support its achievement of its business plan. The department also monitors the Japan Group finances, overall financial performance and provides periodic updates to Japan group management. Broadly, the Finance function consists of two groups (i) Corporate Finance, which provides business planning, business performance forecasting, statutory reporting, as well as tax/treasury services; and (ii) Commercial Finance, which works as a business partner for Marketing and Supply Chain, providing such advices on resource allocation, business case preparation, benefit tracking of investments, channel and brand analysis, and budget management. This position resides within the Commercial Finance group, which is headed by Commercial Finance Controller.

Key Responsibilities

To contribute to the development and execution of strategic planning and decision-making process of the Marketing department e.g. in respect of Investments and Pricing.
To help establish clear goals for the Commercial Finance team in line with company vision, mission, and strategy; and focus self/team efforts in meeting these goals.
To actively contribute in meetings, activities and projects with other members of the senior Marketing team, for planning and review of key initiatives undertaken by Marketing department to achieve the Marketing strategy.
Lead Commercial Finance Brand/Trade in evaluating the effectiveness/efficiency of Marketing programs & touchpoints through financial analysis to support better decision-making and resource allocation; lead the process of benefit realization and tracking. These analyses include
Product/Brand Profitability
Cost implications of product specification changes
Pre- and Post-Implementation Review for new brand/SKU launches
Evaluation of investments in key Marketing initiatives (promotions etc.)
Trade Marketing Region/Area Profitability
Financial evaluations, business cases – NPV, IRR, ROI.
Payback, sensitivity / scenario analysis
Secondary Supply Chain Costs
Review of competitors’ marketing activities
Lead the Company Plan & quarterly budget processes for Marketing. Management and monitoring of expenses and providing meaningful expense variance analysis to marketing and ensuring expenses are in line with planned budgets. Ensure effective budget controls through a robust governance structure
Drive spend efficacy and smart cost management within the Marketing team. Ensure resource allocation decisions are based on enhancing shareholder value and in line with company strategy.
Contribute as a key member of the pricing & excise committee. Lead financial evaluation and scenario analysis of pricing & excise and its impact on portfolio strategy. Evaluate impact of pricing & excise on competition.
Carry out financial and business analysis of key competitors and share key findings with BAT executive committee.
Ensure accounting and governance procedures for Marketing are in place and operating effectively. Identify ways to improve the current control environment & business processes and lead the changes without compromising creativity and enterprising spirit, both within the department and where appropriate within external parties working on our behalf e.g. creative agencies.
Ensure Commercial Finance contributes as an effective business partner to Marketing. Ensure quality service/guidance in all relevant areas of work is provided to all sections (Brands, Trade, Research, Merchandizing, Product Development, and Innovations) of Marketing department, as well as to external customers/suppliers such as distributors and creative agencies.
Lead the process of enhancing/raising the financial awareness of entire Marketing community through formal and on-the job trainings.
Challenge the status quo, becomes an agent of change and proactively manage and motivate team and peers to build commitment to implement changes that improve the business.
Act as a key member of the finance leadership team and provide coaching/leadership support to the team members. Seek continuous learning and development opportunities for self and the team members. Serve as a key development role for finance talent.
Potential Career Path

Commercial Finance Controller
Corporate Finance Controller
Finance Director in small-mid size market outside Japan

Leadership & Management / Behavioural Competencies

Understanding of the relationships / interfaces between departments and functions.
Complexity and subjectivity of marketing requires high commercial approach and strong management and interpersonal skills.
Strong leadership to introduce new systems and procedures.
Ability to work with all levels of staff within the company and handle relationships with external parties.

Personal Characteristics

Proactive, persuasive, creative and prepared to challenge existing ideas

Qualifications & Requirements

10+ years Finance/accounting experience (FMCG industry experience an advantage)
Financial analytical skills such as ROI and NPV to perform/review financial analyses together with the capability to provide commercial insights
Understanding of excise and pricing strategy, company planning process
Understanding of marketing strategy, principles, and relevant analytical tools
background as well as knowledge on commercial aspects of the business such as Trade & Brand Marketing activities
Thorough understanding and knowledge of financial management and systems

The position is part of the Commercial Finance team and involves close collaboration with the Marketing and Supply Chain departments. 

In this position, you will be instrumental in driving strategic planning and decision-making processes, leading a team to achieve financial goals aligned with the company's vision. You will provide financial evaluations to support marketing programs, product launches, and pricing strategies, oversee budgeting processes, manage expenses, and drive cost efficiency. Additionally, you will lead financial evaluations for pricing and excise, perform competitor analysis, and ensure robust accounting and governance procedures are in place.

- Drive cost efficiency and smart resource allocation within the Marketing team to enhance shareholder value.
- Lead financial evaluations and scenario analysis for pricing and excise, and assess their impact on the company's portfolio strategy.
- Perform financial and business analysis of key competitors and share insights with the executive committee.
- Ensure robust accounting and governance procedures are in place and identify opportunities to improve the control environment.

- 10+ years in finance/accounting, preferably within the FMCG industry.
- Strong financial analytical skills, including ROI and NPV analysis, and commercial insights.
- Understanding of excise and pricing strategies, marketing principles, and company planning processes.
- Proven ability to lead teams, introduce new systems, and drive change.
- Ability to work effectively with all levels of staff and external partners.

### Personal Characteristics

- Proactive with the ability to take initiative and drive improvements.
- Strong communication skills to influence decision-making.

If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for finance and a drive to lead, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Job Title: Event and Meeting Operations Manager

Position Overview:

We are currently seeking an experienced Event and Meeting Operations Manager for our esteemed client, a globally recognized travel agency. The successful candidate will be integral in providing top-tier meeting planning and execution services to our clients. This role involves ensuring objectives and deliverables are achieved efficiently and strategically, managing both direct and indirect reports.

Responsibilities:

* Act as the main liaison for managing client relationships while maintaining global account standards.
* Oversee the account to ensure all SOPs, SLAs, and KPIs are regularly achieved.
* Direct a skilled team of professionals (planners, coordinators, specialists) to deliver excellent meeting operations services.
* Evaluate performance against set criteria and formulate actionable plans to address any service issues or performance decline.
* Handle monthly financials related to accounts receivable and unsettled debts, including revenue growth targets, P&L analysis, expense management, and resolution of discrepancies.
* Ensure compliance with all American Express and client policies, including compliance requirements.
* Identify opportunities for productivity and service improvements through effective process management.
* Demonstrate leadership in additional projects, ensuring efficient and strategic delivery.

Candidate Profile:

The ideal candidate is a proven leader with expertise in event management and operations and a record of successful client management. You will need operational experience in managing expert teams for meetings and conferences within a regulated corporate environment. As a proactive thinker, you will be expected to drive results within the team by adhering strictly to SOPs and SLAs.

Qualifications:

* Fluent in both English and Japanese.
* At least 8 years of experience in meeting operations management.
* A minimum of 5 years in a leadership role.
* Experience in customer management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft software, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Proven experience in managing teams.

Preferred Experience:

* Experience in managing both domestic and international clients.
* Familiarity with international event management software, such as Cvent.
* Knowledge of group air ticketing and practical ticketing business experience.

This role provides an exceptional opportunity for leadership and work-life balance. If you are an innovative thinker with superior communication skills and a commitment to providing high-quality service, we encourage you to apply.

NIGHT MANAGER
Job Band
Hotel Level
Department – Front Office
Reports to – Night Manager/Assistant Rooms Division Manager/Rooms Division Manager Our mission is to be the best loved Hotel & Restaurant Company so regardless of position, we look for individuals who are passionate about providing genuine heartfelt care to our guests and employees.
What’s the job?
As the Night Manager/Assistant Night Manager, you will play a lead role in looking after our house, the team, and our guests overnight. You will be involved in all areas of the hotel, bringing departments and teams together to run a smooth operation overnight. Always providing excellent service by going above and beyond to exceed expectations. As the go to person in case of an emergency, strong knowledge of crisis management and emergency procedures for the hotel is essential.
Your day-to-day
 Lead the night team on a day to day basis, ensuring excellent service is provided to all guests in line with our Kimpton points of Distinction
 Lobby presence to meet and greet guests, and ensure enough lobby coverage for a smooth running operation overnight
 Provide a warm greeting and welcome to all guests visiting the hotel whether for Jones Café and Bar, an overnight stay, or simply to see the hotel
 Walk through front and back of house areas, ensuring areas are presentable, maintains the right ambiance, and that health and safety standards are met throughout
 Complete guest check-in’s and check-out’s, and assist Instant Services with answering internal and external calls
 Confirm reservation details on check-in, identifying opportunities for upselling
 Ensure guest information is captured during check-in and updated on guest profile according to company standards and laws
 Acknowledge IHG Rewards Club members. Personalising the acknowledgment based on the guest and level type
 Maintain a warm and friendly manner with each interaction, whilst ensuring efficiency during busy times of check-in, check-out, and receiving calls
 Ensure the same level of guest experience is maintained overnight as during the day by all team members
 Assume the Duty Manager role and overall hotel responsibility overnight
 Review the arrivals report in detail, identify and action any new special requests, VIPs or amenity requirements that have come overnight. Communicate these to other departments as needed
Job Description
NIGHT MANAGER
 Responsible of checking all financial and operational system information prior to running the night audit to ensure accuracy
 Run the night audit after all checks have been completed seeing it to a smooth completion
 Ensure no-show reservations are communicated to Cluster reservations and charged accordingly
 Responsible for the guest issues log - ensuring issues are logged and handled to guest satisfaction and always done so with empathy
 Prepare and send out daily email to the hotel including daily briefing document, arrivals report, guest issues log, no show report, and manager flash report
 Set up show rooms and upsell rooms for the day, communicating these to housekeeping
 Respond to sick calls and communicate these to relevant HODs for coverage to be arranged
 Review room allocations and allocate rooms for early arrivals and prioritise rooms with housekeeping as needed
 Ensure early amenities arranged are placed in the room by Guest Assistants/Karers at the requested time
 Be aware of late evening/early morning car transfers, including booking requested car transfers in the absence of concierge
 Act as a point of contact for VIP guests and group organisers overnight
 Lead by example in encouraging guest feedback, recording and following up on these as appropriate
 Ensure room reservation requests are handled smoothly by the team in the absence of reservations
 Ensure traces are reviewed and actioned during each shift
 Support with the recording and delivery of wake up calls
 Ensure room service orders are taken and delivered accurately and in a timely manner, with a display of full Room Service menu knowledge amongst team members
 Support Front Desk and Instant Services with monitoring and responding to emails within four hours of receiving them to inbox
 Allocate and review room allocations, room moves, early arrivals and group allocations
 Be aware of all VIP guests arriving, in-house, and departing and ensuring they are well looked after
 Meet and greet VIP guests upon arrival and departure, working with ARDM/RDM/HM/GM to coordinate
 Provide a fond farewell to each and every guest on departure, including reviewing consistency of this amongst colleagues
 Build guest profiles through conversations and observations to personalise guest stays
 Attend and lead daily briefings, ensuring all team members know what is happening in the hotel at all times
 Encourage the team to create relationships with guests and create unique Kimpton moments
Job Description
NIGHT MANAGER
 Support with rooming of guests in Karer/Hotel Greeter absence, always walking guests to the lift as a minimum
 Assist Karer/Concierge with guest luggage as needed
 Handling of cash and credit/debit card transactions, including completion of a credit limit during each shift, following up on any credit issues flagged
 Ensure downtime reports are saved every two hours
 Ensure team floats are balanced at the beginning and end of each shift, accurately banking cash, due backs and closing cashiers
 Ensure room discrepancy report is checked and signed off daily, including follow up on reported rooms
 Check newspaper orders and ensure this is completed by Karer as required
 Check public area cleaning with night cleaners, ensuring cleanliness in all areas meet expectations
 Have exceptional knowledge about the hotel product to so you can comfortably talk about and sell hotel offerings including rooms, R&B outlets, retail shop, and meeting rooms
 Ensure exceptional knowledge of the local area and what is going on in the city
 Provide training and feedback to night team regularly, identifying development areas
 Develop and coach the night team through one to one sessions, on the job training, and performance reviews
 Motivate the team to achieve targets in enrolments, upsells, heartbeat, and other social media platforms
 Act as ARDM/RDM in their absence supporting with tasks and responsibilities
 Complete understanding of IT support available and lines to contact for prompt solving of both guest and departmental IT issues
 Strongly understand the hotel’s fire, emergency, and bomb threat procedures overnight, assuming the coordinators role in an emergency
 Maintain high confidentiality in regards to guest privacy, keeping guest details secure at all times
 Work in a safe manner, taking yourself, your colleagues, and guests into consideration
 Ensure that all potential and real hazards are reported appropriately and immediately, including any suspicious behaviour of guests and staff
Job Description
NIGHT MANAGER
What we need from you
 Leadership skills – the team will turn to you for your expert knowledge, support, and guidance. You will be a hands-on leader by example
 Communication skills - guests and team members will need to come to you with concerns as well as compliments, so you will be easy to talk to
 Your problem-solving skills will turn issues into opportunities so every guest leaves with great memories
 Crisis management skills – you will be the go to person in case of emergencies overnight; crisis management knowledge with a good head on your shoulders is vital
 Fluency in Japanese and English - extra language skills would be great, but not essential
Literate and tech-savvy – you will need a good grasp of reading, writing, basic maths and computers
 Flexibility - weekend and holiday shifts are all part of the job
 You will have a high school diploma or qualification. A college or university degree would be a bonus, but not essential
 Experience - ideally you will have spent at least one year in a manager position within Front Office
 Bring yourself! We want to see you flourish in your role by truly being you
There’s so much more to the job than we can capture here. It’s simply about creating great experiences, doing the right thing and understanding people.
Job Description
NIGHT MANAGER
How do I deliver this?
Kimpton believes that heartfelt connections make people’s lives better. Our colleagues are empowered and encouraged to act from the heart, to go above and beyond to create ridiculously personal experiences for each other and our guests.
Our Kimpton brand culture encourages colleagues to be their best selves, and we celebrate the differences of each employee. This is reinforced through on-going cultural cornerstones which ensure the Kimpton spirit is consistently experienced across our hotels, no matter where we are in the world.
Working at Kimpton is not just about working. And it’s certainly not like working at other places. We value personality, individuality, creativity, doing right, continually improving, focus and passion.
Here, you can:
Be Yourself
Who you are is who we are. So bring the real you. The best and ever-improving version of you. Bring your background, your personality, your individuality, your creativity. It’s those just-you qualities that make it more personal for you, and our guests.
Lead Yourself
We support you, and you support we. We trust you to give it your all, take initiative, do right when no one’s watching, find creative new ways to delight guests and co-workers. We trust you to learn, grow and continually improve at whatever you do.

Senior Manager – Procurement (Data Center)
Who We Are
Princeton Digital Group (PDG) is a leading developer and operator of Internet infrastructure.
Headquartered in Singapore with presence and operations in China, Singapore, India,
Indonesia, Malaysia, and Japan, its portfolio of data centers powers the expansion of
hyperscalers and enterprises in the fastest-growing digital economies across Asia. With 21
data centers in 15 cities across 6 countries and counting, we help hyperscalers and
enterprises unleash their growth potential. Our strategic model and a portfolio of exceptional
capacity and pipeline equates to unlimited opportunities in Asia’s high-growth markets.
PDG is backed by blue-chip investors - Warburg Pincus, a leading global private equity firm
with a successful history of creating world-class technology, media, and telecommunications
(TMT) and real estate platforms, Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan (OTPP), Canada's largest
single profession pension plan with $204.7 billion in net assets and Mubadala Investment
Company, a sovereign investor that manages a diverse global portfolio for the Government
of Abu Dhabi.
Build your career with PDG, where we offer an unparalleled platform with exciting career
growth opportunities across countries and functions. PDG upholds the highest level of
governance and is committed to provide a safe and healthy work environment for all our
employees. At PDG, diversity and inclusion are valued, and every individual's opinion matters.
We promote an open and collaborative culture and encourage everyone to take ownership in
building a great company together.
For more information, visit www.princetondg.com
We Are Looking For
As the Senior Manager – Procurement (Data Center), you will report to the
Managing Director and manage the Procurement team. You will be accountable for
overseeing all procurement related activities for various projects (CAPEX) & operations
(OPEX) that enable PDG to complete projects in a timely and cost-efficient manner.
Additionally, it would be required to perform compliance & MIS activities to ensure data integrity
in all procurement related activities.
You possess a strong and solid experience in data center MEP (mechanical, electrical, and
plumbing) procurement. You also have strong leadership, communication skills with
tenants/vendors and technical skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with other
departments within the organization.
Job Responsibilities
• Gather Requirements and Identify Vendors:
• Obtain procurement requirements from user teams.
• Identify and evaluate both existing and new vendors to meet these requirements.
• Manage RFPs and Analyze Bids:
• Issue Requests for Proposals (RFPs), gather quotations, conduct price comparisons,
and analyze bids to identify target cost areas for negotiation.
• Ensure accuracy in the bid comparison process by monitoring and analyzing
submitted bids.
• Prepare approval and recommendation notes.
• Vendor Management and Relationship Building:
• Conduct thorough vendor evaluations.
• Manage end-to-end vendor relationships to ensure quality and reliability.
• Engage with cross-functional business leaders on matters of RFPs, technical
submissions, and quotation follow-ups.
• Achieve Procurement Targets and Cost Savings:
• Ensure procurement targets are met at various project milestones, focusing on
supplier support, cost, timely delivery, quality, qualification, processes, and
equipment.
• Track and manage cost savings projects.
• Address Queries and Manage Compliance:
• Act as the point of contact for procurement and purchase order-related queries,
resolving issues for the assigned region or project.
• Ensure compliance with procurement processes and internal policies.
• Manage Procurement Procedures and Compliance:
• Follow, communicate, and manage detailed procurement project procedures.
• Ensure Engineering/Project teams comply with these procedures during project
phases.
• Review Agreements and Ensure Compliance:
• Check the basic content of agreements from a commercial perspective.
• Review existing contracts and agreements to ensure compliance with usage terms.
Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering is a must.
• Must possess working experience in MEP engineering procurement of a data center.
• Must have experience of carrying out RFP/tender procedure, agreement closure and
working in ERP (Oracle/SAP/Netsuite).
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
• Assertive and confident personality.
• Exceptional customer experience and leadership skills.

CIB Finance Japan is committed to be a valued Business Partner to the Métiers and other Functions in their daily business activities and development plans by providing them with timely and high quality financial information to make informed business decisions to effectively achieve their strategic goals.

Managing the accounting closing of Securities company and Bank branch
Review of Head Office Reporting under IFRS performed by Regional Finance
Local regulatory reporting under broker dealer and banking license
Local statutory reporting under JGAAP
Tax computation and support for tax filing
Financial analysis, monitoring of revenue and costs including internal reporting for the entity
Define accounting treatment for new products

Performing various controls built within the accounting and reporting processes, and contribute to the application of BNPP accounting control plan

Maintaining daily/monthly net capital ratio at sufficient level with facing off business
Ensuring accurate and timely submission of local regulatory reports including liquidity reports
Assessing impacts of new products/trades from accounting and regulatory capital perspective
Corresponding with external/internal auditors and regulators
Providing financial analysis and presentation to the CFO and stakeholders including cost and revenue monitoring/analysis/reporting by business 
Driving enhancements and operational process improvements in production, control procedures, and workflow organization to increase efficiency and effectiveness
Handling adhoc requirements on financial accounting
Managing and leading entire team including task assignment/coordination, setting objectives and  monitoring the progress
Managing and motivating people with continuous feedback and annual appraisal
Leading staff for successful completion of the new tasks and projects/initiatives

Ensuring good coordination and communication with the CIB Finance teams in the Region

Contributing to cross border / company‐wide / ITO projects

We are looking for a Legal, Ethics & Compliance Counsel to join our team at Novo Nordisk in Japan. If you are ready to utilize your expertise to enable business growth while defending against legal, compliance, and reputational risks, then read on and apply today for a life-changing career.

 

About the department
Novo Nordisk is a global healthcare company with 100 years of innovation and supervision in diabetes care. This heritage has given us experience and capabilities that also enable us to help people defeat obesity, haemophilia, growth disorders and other serious chronic diseases.
In the team, you are to exercise approval authority regarding contracts, communication materials and other liable matters as well as good judgment and flexibility while ensuring alignment within Legal & Compliance Department and with other local/global stakeholders.

 

The position
As our Legal, Ethics & Compliance Counsel, you are expected to utilize expertise on legal and ethics & compliance, enable business in Japan to achieve growth initiatives while defending the company from major legal, compliance, and reputational risks.
The role responsibilities are as follows but not limited to:

In the role of Business Partnering at Novo Nordisk Japan, the individual is responsible for supporting business leaders in making informed decisions and achieving growth objectives across various business functions. This includes providing legal and compliance support in areas such as contract law, intellectual property, corporate law, data protection, pharma regulation, and more. The focus is on intelligent risk-taking while defending the company from legal, compliance, and reputational risks. The role involves addressing business challenges, coordinating with global stakeholders, and ensuring comprehensive coverage of legal and compliance aspects for the business.
Contracting: Advising on, drafting, reviewing, and approving, and negotiating on various types of contracts (e.g., clinical trial, post market study, investigator sponsored study, joint research, wholesaler and distribution, employment, procurement, alliance and partnerships) to enable business leaders to achieve growth initiatives while defending the company from major legal, compliance, and reputational risks.

Process implementation and ownership: Plan, lead, and execute the implementation of the requirements of local regulations and Novo Nordisk’s global policies through coordination with local and global stakeholders.
Process optimization: Identify opportunities for optimization of existing processes and policies, as well as plan, lead, and execute optimization projects (digitization, automation, and simplification) to achieve more simplicity and agility for both Legal & Compliance team and business leaders, while maintaining required level of control.  Also, cultivating compliance culture, live the value of integrity, and be able to nurture such mindset among all employees to create the same environment.

Lawyer qualification in Japan (弁護士) and minimum of 3 years of experience at law firm, or legal division in a company is required.

Curiosity in healthcare industry and learning and personal development.

Ultimately, life is why we’re all here - to ensure that people can lead a life free of chronic disease.

We need to aspire to be the best company for the world and we know that this is only possible with talented employees with diverse perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. JOB DETAILS
 

Are you an experienced HR professional looking for a new challenge? Do you have a passion for developing human resource strategies and policies? We are currently seeking an HR Business Partner (HRBP) for our Koriyama Factory (KFA) in the People ＆ Organization (P&O) Department. If you are ready to make a difference and contribute to the success of our organization, read on and apply today for a life-changing career.
 

About the department
The P&O Department at KFA in charge of managing the human resources of the factory. We work closely with the factory management to develop and implement human resource strategies that meet the business needs of the factory. Our team is devoted in attracting, developing, and retaining top talent to ensure the success of the factory. With a fast-paced and dynamic atmosphere, the P&O Department at KFA offers a collaborative work environment where you can make a difference and contribute to the overall success of the factory.

 

The position
The role involves effectively managing the P&O Department to ensure the successful execution of key P&O activities at the KFA site, delivering value-added P&O services in collaboration with Novo Nordisk Pharma (NNPL) P&O functions, aligning them with business needs, and contribute to business priorities (80%). Additionally, the position requires working on the factory P&O activities upon request from the P&O Manager for the KFA Factory (20%).
As an HRBP at Novo Nordisk, you will:

Ensure compliance with local labor legislation and company requirements for HR processes and systems at KFA, collaborating with NNPL P&O functions when necessary, covering areas such as recruitment, on-boarding, performance management, compensation and benefits, training, and personnel administration.
Drive activities and training aimed at cultural evolution to support organizational needs and create an innovative and inclusive environment.
Promote Novo Nordisk as the best employer and support attraction and retention of top talent through the KFA employer value proposition.
Provide daily human resource advice to line managers, covering staff management, remuneration, motivation, and development.
Maintain contact with stakeholders while complying to the business ethics principles and local legislation.
 

Qualifications

University degree or higher education.
Fluency in Japanese and proficiency in English at a business level is essential.
At least 5 years of practical HR experience, with solid business expertise, organizational development, change management, succession, and talent management knowledge.
Familiarity with Japanese Labor law, preferably with factory HR experience and exposure to pharmaceutical or regulated industries.
Ability to quickly establish credibility, build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, work collaboratively, and act as a role model for the organization. Also, adept at problem-solving, compassionate personalities and behavioral styles, demonstrating strong employment law knowledge, manufacturing acumen, and strategic problem-solving skills.

Working at Novo Nordisk
We are a proud life-science company, and life is our reason to exist. We’re inspired by life in all its forms and shapes, ups and downs, opportunities, and challenges. For employees at Novo Nordisk, life means many things – from the building blocks of life that form the basis of ground-breaking scientific research, to our rich personal lives that motivate and energize us to perform our best at work. Ultimately, life is why we’re all here - to ensure that people can lead a life independent of chronic disease.

 

Contact
Upload your CV to our online career page (click on Apply and follow the instructions).

 

Deadline
Until the completion of recruitment.
Applications will be screened on an ongoing basis, so you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.
 

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants. 
 
At Novo Nordisk we recognize that it is no longer good enough to aspire to be the best company in the world. We need to aspire to be the best company for the world and we know that this is only possible with talented employees with diverse perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. We are therefore committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates the diversity of our employees, the patients we serve and communities we operate in. Together, we’re life changing.

We’re looking for Club InterContinental Assistant Manager to take ownership of delivering exceptional first impressions – managing everything from registration and reservations to porter and concierge services.

お客様の記憶に残る体験を、あなたがお届けしませんか？

受付、予約からポーター、コンシェルジュサービスに至るまで、すべてを管理し、卓越した第一印象を提供するオーナーシップを持つクラブインターコンチネンタルアシスタントマネージャーを募集しています。

What is the job?​

Great Club InterContinental Memories come from many places. The sights, sounds, scents and importantly the service. As a Club Manager, you will deliver memorable and meaningful experiences to our guests through managing all aspects of the club lounge operation from welcoming our guests to the lounge, completing appropriate transactions, to recommending food and drinks. You will be responsible for providing the seamless day-to-day operation as the person in charge of the club lounge with the aim of achieving the highest guest satisfaction.

Club InterContinentalの素晴らしい思い出は、さまざまな場所から生まれます。景色、音、香り、そして何よりもサービス。クラブIインターコンチネンタルアシスタントマネージャーとして、クラブラウンジのすべての側面を管理し、お客様に思い出に残る意味ある体験を提供します。ラウンジへのお客様の歓迎から適切な取引の完了、飲食物の提案まで、日々の運営を円滑に行い、最高のお客様満足度を達成することを目指します。

Your day to day​

Guest Experience​

​• Monitor the club lounge for seating availability, service and wellbeing of guests.​

•Ensure the brand standards are being complied in all aspects of the operation.​

•Ensure that the team acknowledges IHG One Rewards members, InterContinental Ambassadors and returning guests.​

•Liaise with relevant departments so that guest requests are handled efficiently, including VIP needs. ​

•Make sure all facilities are clean and properly stocked to anticipated business volume. Notify engineering immediately of any maintenance and repair needs.​

•Ensure guests are greeted upon arrival and make time to engage with guests. Respond appropriately to guest complaints, solicit feedback and build relationships to drive continuous improvement in guest satisfaction​

・クラブラウンジの席の状況や、サービス、お客様の満足度などを常にモニターします。

・IHGが定めるブランドスタンダードが遵守されていることを確認します。

・チームがIHG One Rewardsや、InterContinentalアンバサダー、リピーターゲストを認識し、対応できるようにします。

・関連する部門と連携して、VIPのニーズや、お客様のリクエストが効率的に対応できるようにします。

・ラウンジが清潔で充分な在庫があることを確認し、予想される業務量に対応します。メンテナンスや修理が必要な場合はエンジニアリングにすぐに連絡します。

・到着時にゲストに挨拶し、ゲストと交流する時間を作ります。ゲストのクレームに対応し、ゲストから頂いたフィードバックからゲスト満足度の向上を促進し、ゲストとの関係を築いていきます。

​ People​

•Ensure that the team is properly trained and understand federal, state and local laws and regulations.​

•Manage day-to-day staffing needs, plan and assign work and establish performance and development goals for team members.​

•Provide mentoring, coaching and regular feedback to improve team member performance.​

•Ensure that the team is provided with adequate trainings, equipment and tools to carry out duties.​

・チームが適切にトレーニングされ、日本の法律および規則を理解していることを確認します。

・日々のスタッフのニーズを管理し、業務を計画し、割り当て、チームメンバーのパフォーマンスと成長目標を確立します。

・チームメンバーのパフォーマンスを向上させるためにメンタリング、コーチング、定期的なフィードバックを提供します。

・チームが業務を遂行するために適切なトレーニング、機器、ツールが提供されるようにします。

Financial​

•Help prepare a monthly profit and loss statement.​

•Monitor and control labor costs, food and beverage costs and other expenses.​

•Develop plans to increase revenue at the club lounge through upselling rooms, food and beverage outlets and spa.​

・月次の損益計算書の作成をサポートをします。

・労働コスト、飲食費、およびその他の経費をモニターし、管理します。

・クラブラウンジの収益を増加させるための計画を立て、ゲストルーム、レストラン、スパなどのアップセルを促進します。

​Responsible Business​

•Ensure the team follows the appropriate procedures to protect safety and security of guests and colleagues.​

•Supervise the team so that cash and credit card transactions are properly handled.​

•Perform other duties as assigned.​

・チームが適切な手続きに従ってゲストと同僚の安全とセキュリティを保護するようにします。

・チームが現金およびクレジットカードの取引を適切に処理するように監督します。

・指定された他の職務を遂行します。

What We Need from You

・Fluency in Japanese and English – Extra language skills would be an advantage, but not essential.​

・Minimum three years of experience in the club lounge or in the relevant field including supervisory experience.​

・Solid experience in front desk or concierge operations would be an advantage.​

・Bachelor’s degree / higher education qualification / equivalent in Hotel Management/Business Administration. ​

・日本語と英語の流暢なコミュニケーション能力 - 他の言語話せる方優遇

Job Description
Opportunity Snapshot

This position offers you the opportunity to join the world's leading data center experts:
•	We are the largest wholesale data center provider in the world.
•	We work with the biggest customers.
•	You'll gain broad exposure to the data center business, expanding your knowledge of design & construction, operations, asset management, property management and other areas.
•	You'll join a seasoned team in Sales Engineering and work with recognized industry leaders on this and other Digital Realty teams.
•	You'll enjoy the most diverse career options in a strong-growth organization.
In this role you will perform client, tenant and customer-facing engineering functions in support of customer acquisition, installation scope and custom construction scope, with an emphasis on retail colocation business.

The Role

You will become part of our larger Sales Engineering team. You will support the sales team in technical sales solutions in your region and be involved almost from the beginning of any sale. We have a Property Management team on site, and you'll need to develop strong working relationships with this group, as well as with the Design and Construction team. At any given time, you will be contributing to multiple sales efforts at various stages. While it can vary, a typical sales cycle looks like this:
•	You will lead efforts to respond to RFPs.
•	Conduct a tour of one of our data centers, providing technical information.
•	You'll support lease negotiations by (1) interpreting the lease to ensure the terms match with the technical specs and (2) supporting pricing efforts, including estimating move-in, power, materials and other costs.
•	Once the lease is signed you will coordinate implementation and deployment, acting as the "face" of Digital Realty until the customer's network and equipment are up and running smoothly.
More specifically, you will:
•	Support sales teams in technical sales and solutions in all markets.
•	Direct prospect engagements, including leading building and site tours, sales calls and proposal generation, and pricing and contract negotiations.
•	Act as the primary input channel for operations from sales teams.
•	Evaluate customer needs, and then design and present a preliminary solution.
•	Serve as primary responder for all customer RFPs.
•	Develop cost-engineering and profitability models for large customer opportunities.
•	Support Design and Construction Teams in regional markets.
•	Provide input, support and essential "local knowledge" for construction projects in the surrounding markets.
•	Act as a subject matter expert related to the infrastructure, nuances and pitfalls associated with assigned buildings.
•	Act as an "eyes-on" resource for remote design and construction teams during bid, construction and commissioning processes.
•	Generate sales leads through professional contacts and networking.
•	Participate in forecasting, pipeline and market analysis.
•	Liaise with the professional community, including attending technical forums and presenting papers at industry events.
•	Monitor and evaluate trends in prospect, customer and target tenant base.

Note: this description is intended to give you a general overview of the position and is not an exhaustive listing of duties and responsibilities.

Qualifications
The Requirements

To be a good fit for this opportunity you will have:
•	2-3 years of solid experience in a B2B sales environment, developing segmentation and go to market strategies preferably in telecommunications, networking, internet, data security, hosting, high tech facilities or related fields.
•	Customer-facing skills preferably developed in sales roles, and a demonstrated ability to talk with big data/power users intelligently about data center or similar solutions.
•	Technical savvy and a basic understanding of IT infrastructure needs.
•	Proven project management skills.
•	Expert application software skills including MS Word, MS Excel, and Visio; AutoCAD; and Adobe Acrobat.
•	The ability to:
o	Grasp big picture requirements and translate them into detail-level specifications.
o	Comprehend, analyze, and interpret complex project documents.
o	Apply installation standards and project tracking / management documents.
•	A bachelor's degree, ideally in an analytical field like engineering.
•	A strong command of language skill, both English and Japanese, to build solid relationship between multiple stakeholders

You will spend a good deal of time out in the field, primarily at data centers. You can also expect to be called upon to support data centers in other markets as needed. Most travel will involve day trips, but you should be prepared to travel overnight about 25% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications
Preferred but not required:
•	Product management experience in the IT infrastructure industry.
•	Consulting experience in the areas of segmentation, business development, channel development and go to market strategies.

Portrait of a person
Just as important as your experience and skills will be the following characteristics and competencies:
•	A strong commitment to delivering excellent customer service to clients and co-workers.
•	The ability to:
o	Learn and apply technical and business concepts quickly.
o	Effectively respond, verbally or in writing, to sensitive issues, complex inquiries or complaints.
o	Make effective presentations and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers and the general public.
o	Work well under pressure and take a proactive approach to unusual occurrences.

About the job
Senior Tax Consultant (Financial Services and Real Estate)
For international clients to compete in the Japanese financial and real estate markets, knowledge of Japanese and overseas tax regimes applicable to the financial services industry is crucial. Familiarity with tax analyses, interpretation of tax treaties, transfer pricing and judicious tax planning are fundamental for tax-efficient operations that optimize investor returns and shareholder value. In addition, as products traded in the financial markets and alternative asset classes become more complex, having tax professionals with experience working in and with the financial services industry helps PwC understand our clients’ needs, to propose and deliver bespoke solutions.

Role and Responsibilities
•	Work in a team to provide tax advice to major US, European and APAC funds, as well as startups, on investment structures and acquisition transactions.
•	Apply growing technical knowledge to analyze finance and real estate transactions and draft tax memoranda and reports with relevant implications and viable options.
•	Engage in projects involving capital markets, investment management, private equity, real estate, renewables, infrastructure, aviation leasing and insurance matters.
•	Collaborate with clients and our international network firms on complex international platforms and cross-border investment structuring projects.
•	Coordinate and participate in tax due diligence engagements, including in the form of English-language transaction document review from a tax perspective.
•	Prepare illustrative tax diagrams and calculations and familiarize yourself with evolving digital technologies in our day-to-day business and that of our clients.
•	Be actively involved in business development activities, including the creation of client proposals and support in the organization of client conferences and events.
•	Take responsibility for developing your business acumen, keeping up to date with economic issues and industry insights to understand client needs and add value.
•	Have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, and be ready to share your increasing experience and technical knowledge with clients and your team.

PwC Tax Japan is a member firm of the PwC global network, with more than 280,000 staff working in over 150 countries around the world. We have a growing practice offering a full range of tax advisory and compliance services in connection with sophisticated financial instruments and investment structures. PQL(Product Quality Leader) for EE

Department: Product Quality & Safety (BP73100)

職務概要
日本国内および海外市場における製品品質問題を調査・分析し、その結果に基づき、必要に応じて製品の品質改善あるいは問題の解決を図り、品質を確保します。品質改善や問題解決のプロセスにおいては、市場の要求や顧客の声を反映させるとともに、優先順位を明確にして対応し、効果的な改善を行います。
また、国土交通省に係る対応として、年次リコール監査の受監の他、個別問い合わせ事案への回答作成等を行います。
開発・製造などにおいてあらゆる注意を払って作られた車でも、市場において大なり小なり品質問題が起こることがあります。本ポジションは、品質問題が発生した場合、お客様への影響を最小限に抑えること、品質パフォーマンスを確保するために重要な役割を担います。
　主に、以下のような業務を担当していただきます。
１．市場の製品品質の調査・改善に係る業務
　１) 市場品質情報を受け取り、内容を精査し調査の要否判断や対応を検討。
　２) 市場品質情報の調査結果について、市場・顧客への回答。
　３) 市場品質情報の調査・分析結果に基づき、設計品質を含む製品品質改善の提案。
　４) 市場品質情報の調査・分析結果に基づき、市場措置要否の提案。
　５) セールス部門との定期会議を行い、市場や顧客の声の収集と品質問題を共有。
２．国土交通省に係る対応業務
　１) 国土交通省の年次リコール監査の受監・指摘事項への回答。
　２) 国土交通省へおよび関連省庁などからの問い合わせ事案への回答案作成。

Job summary:
We investigate and analyze product quality problems in the Japanese and overseas markets, and based on the results, we improve product quality or resolve problems as necessary to ensure quality. In the process of quality improvement and problem solving, we will reflect market demands and customer feedback, and will respond with clear priorities to ensure effective improvements.
In addition, as a response to the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT), we will conduct annual recall audits and prepare responses to individual inquiries.
Even if a vehicle has been developed and manufactured with the utmost care and attention, quality problems may occur in the market to a greater or lesser degree. This position plays an important role in minimizing the impact on customers and ensuring quality performance when quality problems occur.
The primary responsibilities of this position will include the following.
１．Work related to the investigation and improvement of product quality in the market.
　１) Receive market quality information, scrutinize its contents. And consider whether or not to conduct an investigation and how to take care it.
　２) Respond to the market and customers regarding the results of market quality information investigations.
　３) Propose product quality improvements, including design quality, based on the results of investigations and analysis of market quality information.
　４) Propose whether or not market measures are necessary based on the results of investigation and analysis of market quality information.
　５) Hold regular meetings with the sales department to gather market and customer feedback and share quality issues.

必要な資格など
１．大学技術系コース卒業もしくは同等のレベル
２．語学
　１) 日本語が堪能であること（読み、書き、会話）、市場および販売会社へ回答するための正確な文書作成ならびに会話力
　２) 英語は中級レベル以上（社内コミュニケーションが取れる程度の英語力）
３．能力
　１) 内外問わず良好なコミュニケーションが取れること
　２) 製品品質に係る社内関連部署との活動において、積極的にリード出来ること
　３) 緊急、重要案件などに対しても客観的に冷静な判断が出来ること
　４) どのような状況下においても、倫理価値観を前提に行動できること
４．必要な経験・知識
　　エンジニアとしてのバックグラウンドを有し、製造業において品質保証業務または開発や生産に係る業務いずれかの実務経験があること。
　　さらに以下に関わる業務経験もしくは相当の知識などがあることが望ましい。
　　・自動車業界での製品品質に係る業務経験
　　・自動車の構造(特に電子電装部品)や道路運送車両法、保安基準に関する知識

Required Competencies/Experiences:
１．Graduation from a university technical course or equivalent
２．Language Skill
 　１) Fluent Japanese (reading, writing and speaking). Accurate writing and conversational skills to respond to market and sales departments.
 　２) Intermediate level of English or higher. (Enough English to communicate within the company)
３．Competencies
 　１) Be able to communicate well both internally and externally.　
 　２) Be able to proactively take the lead in activities related to product quality with related internal departments.
 　３) Be able to make objective and calm judgments on urgent and important matters.
 　４) Be able to act based on ethical values under any circumstances.
４．Required experience and knowledge
　　Must have a background in engineering and experience in either quality assurance or development and production related work in a manufacturing environment.
　　In addition, it is desirable to have the following work experience or equivalent knowledge.
　　・Experience in product quality in the automotive industry
　　・Knowledge of automobile structure (especially electronics and electrical components)
　　・Road Transport Vehicle Law Safety Standards

PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns.

Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking.  We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.

We are seeking a Marketing Manager to join the Japan Marketing team to help execute high quality, highly effective marketing programs to achieve the firm’s objectives with particular focus on various events and external conferences. This multifaceted role requires a hands-on approach, excellent organizational skills and an aptitude for problem solving. •	Strong level of writing skills in client communication in Japanese

•	Ability to negotiate and work effectively as a manager across business channels and external vendors

どんな仕事か
当社は戦略・業務・IT等、幅広いテーマでのコンサルティングを提供している総合コンサルティング会社です。
顧客企業は、日本を代表する大企業から新進気鋭のスタートアップ企業まで多岐に渡り、ヘルスケア、製造、通信、流通、エネルギー、IT、証券、保険等、幅広い業界で、累計で数百社に上ります。

コンサルティングのテーマは、戦略策定から実行支援まで全方位的に提供可能な体制を整えています。
顧客企業からの信頼や満足度が非常に高いため、一つのプロジェクトの支援からリピートで複数のテーマの継続支援に繋がることも多く、各企業の抱える課題に対し深くまで入り込んだ経営サポートを実現しています。

現在の当社は、社員はコンサルティングの提供に留まらず、自社の組織・仕組み作りにも携われる最も面白いフェーズにあり、他社にはない成長機会を豊富に経験することが可能です。

この仕事の魅力
◇『ワンプール制』による幅広いプロジェクトへのアサイン
・社内組織に業界・業種やソリューションでのセグメンテーションがないため、各コンサルタントが多様な業界や経営テーマのプロジェクトに関わることが可能
・プロジェクトアサイン前に経営陣と必ず面談をし、スキル経験（できること）×志向性（やりたいこと）を勘案した上で、各コンサルタントの中長期のキャリアパスに最も合ったプロジェクトへのアサインを実現

◇ 高い年俸・昇給率と早い昇格スピード
・給与水準は外資/国内の有名コンサルティング会社と同等かそれ以上
・全社約240名規模かつ急成長中のため、上が詰まっておらず、成果と能力が伴えば最短1年で次のポジションに昇格可能 （20代後半のマネージャー、30代前半のシニアマネージャー、30代半ばのパートナーも数多く在籍）
・評価制度は目標に応じた定量評価をベースに、会社貢献の定性評価を加点した絶対評価。客観性・公平性に優れており、好成績を収めることで大幅な昇給が可能（2021年度の昇給率実績は約15%）

◇コンサル業界でも随一のワークライフバランスを実現
・クライアントに価値を出すためにはメンバーが活力を維持することや自己研鑽のための時間が重要と考え、WLBとクライアントへの価値提供を両立させている（Well-Being経営の実践）
・平均月間残業時間は約28時間（2021年度実績。自己成長に向けた社内施策活動含む）

◇社内施策と自社経営への関与
・通常のコンサル会社では、自社経営と現場コンサルタントの間に壁があるが、当社では各自がプロジェクト以外に自身の志向性やキャリア形成に合った社内施策に所属し、自社の経営課題解決や組織作りに関与
・各施策はメンバーが主体的に取り組み、実施内容を設計・推進。社員自身のスキルアップや、活発かつ風通しがよい組織形成に大きく寄与
・会社の変化を間近で体感することができ、将来の起業やスタートアップ経営を考えるメンバーには他にない経験

◇充実した人材育成の制度

・内定から入社までの間、入社後のスタートダッシュのための準備プログラムを提供（希望制）
・コンサル未経験者には入社後一定期間の重点フォローアップを実施し、つまずきがちなポイントを会社としてサポート

・コンサル熟練者や品質管理本部によるプロジェクトアサイン中の実践的フィードバックやサポートのOJTを実施

◇『ワンプール制』の弱点を補強する『プラクティス制』や『品質管理本部』の導入
・ワンプール制のメリットを享受しながらも、極端なジェネラリスト組織化を回避するため、10以上の専門領域をプラクティスとして設置

Job Title: Business Strategy Consultant

Our prestigious client, a prominent consulting firm in Tokyo, Japan, is in search of a resourceful, goal-oriented Business Strategy Consultant. This full-time role presents an invigorating prospect to employ your prowess in business strategy and consulting in propelling our client's business.

Primary Responsibilities:

- Delivering wide-ranging consulting services across diverse sectors such as healthcare, manufacturing, communications, retail, energy, IT, finance, and insurance.
- Assisting clients with strategic planning and execution support, catering to both start-ups and established corporations.
- Enabling business transformation through the introduction of leading-edge technologies such as AI, IoT, and blockchain.
- Facilitating the formulation and launch of digitalization strategies and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs).
- Assisting in the planning and implementation of new business strategies, M&A activities, and international expansion plans.
- Providing operational reform consulting, inclusive of new business/system design, solution selection, deployment management, and post-launch support.
- Offering IT consulting services, encompassing IT strategy development, IT governance/reform, IT cost reduction, and broad business transformation.

Essential Qualifications:

- A minimum of three years of professional experience.
- Experience in consulting or system development, sales, marketing, and planning in IT-related firms.
- A university degree or equivalent.
- Proficiency in English is an advantage.

Significant Aspects of the Role:

This role offers exposure to an array of projects via our "One Pool System", a competitive salary with a quick promotion track, and a balanced work-life with an average of just 28 hours of overtime per month. It also provides the chance to partake in the company's internal strategies and business operations and offers extensive employee training programs.

Potential candidates should expect a multi-phase interview process, which can be carried out online to accommodate individual schedules. The final compensation package will be determined based on the candidate's skills and experience.

This position is an excellent fit for those who are passionate about problem-solving, excel in a brisk environment, and are keen to make a profound impact on our client's business performance. Apply today to expedite your career in business strategy consulting.

The Finance department in BATJ exists to provide both strategic directions / guidance to the management and the organization of BAT Japan Group (the “Group”) and operational finance services the Group in order to support its achievement of its business plan. The department also monitors the Japan Group finances, overall financial performance and provides periodic updates to Japan group management. Broadly, the Finance function consists of two groups: (i) Corporate Finance, which provides business planning, business performance forecasting, statutory reporting, as well as tax/treasury services; and (ii) Commercial Finance, which works as a business partner for Marketing and Supply Chain, providing such advices on resource allocation, business case preparation, investment return and spends effectiveness, channel and brand analysis, and budget management. This position resides within the Commercial Finance, which is headed by Commercial Finance Controller.

To contribute to the development and execution of strategic planning and decision-making process of the Marketing department e.g. in respect of Investments and Pricing.
To actively contribute in meetings, activities and projects with other members of the senior Marketing team, for planning and review of key initiatives undertaken by Marketing department to achieve the business targets.

Product/Brand Profitability (incl. pricing decision)
Business case and Post-Implementation Review for new brand/SKU launches
Evaluation of investments in key Marketing initiatives (promotions etc.)
Trade Marketing Region/Area Profitability
Financial evaluations, business cases – NPV, IRR, ROI.
Payback, sensitivity / scenario analysis
Secondary Supply Chain Costs

Engaging in Strategic Planning and Decision Making

• Analyzes information, forecasts sales against expenses and creates annual budget plans.
• Compiles information, analyzes and monitors actual sales against projected sales.

• Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.
• Thinks creatively and practically to develop, execute and implement new business plans
